scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:migrate -w casingconnect-api && npm run prisma:seed -w casingconnect-api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev -w casingconnect-api" "npm run dev -w casingconnect-web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w casingconnect-api && npm run test:e2e -w casingconnect-api
